**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole apples are denser than cut pieces, about 0.85 g/ml, so 200 ml × 0.85 ≈ 170 g. This is consistent with a medium apple weighing about 150 to 180 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Raw apple is about 52 kcal per 100 g. 170 g × 0.52 ≈ 88 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** One medium apple is about 80 to 100 kcal and about 170 g, which fits what is visible. Nothing else is on the plate.
